# dragon_knight (고룡기사)

## Identity

- Elite dragon-blood knight, attacker role, natural 5★
- Tall human male warrior in heavy jagged dragon-scale plate armor
- Horned draconic helm with narrow visor; pale stern face partially visible
- Charcoal-black scale plates with sharp obsidian edges and layered pauldrons
- Large tattered dragon wings with membrane glow and a long torn battle cape
- Massive two-handed volcanic greatsword with magma core in the blade
- Magma-orange light bleeds through armor seams at chest, belt, knees and blade
- Grounded wide combat stance, sword tip near the ground in the right hand
- **Keep across elements**: human knight body, horned helm, scale armor layout,
  wing and cape structure, greatsword silhouette, wide grounded stance
- **Change per element**: seam glow, wing membrane energy, blade aura and pauldron trim only

## artKey

`dragon_knight_{element}` — fire / water / wind / light / dark

## Element variants

- **fire**: orange-red magma seams, ember wing membranes, volcanic blade glow
- **water**: teal-blue seam light, wet metal highlights, frost-ice blade core
- **wind**: emerald-lime seam energy, airy wing trails, sharp wind-etched blade
- **light**: gold-white holy seam radiance, bright wing membranes, radiant blade core
- **dark**: violet-black void seams, shadow mist on wings, curse-glyph blade aura

## Awaken delta

- Same silhouette with evolved horned crown-helm and heavier wing armature
- Blade grows longer with split magma/element core and ornate crossguard
- Cape becomes armored mantle; pauldrons gain dragon-skull trim
- Brighter controlled elemental aura without hiding the body
- Portrait: dragon_knight_{element}_awaken.webp
- Battle: dragon_knight_{element}-awaken-front.webp / -awaken-back.webp

## Front/back requirements

- **front**: helm face slit, chest seams, sword, wings leading edge and boots readable
- **back**: wing membrane structure, cape attachment, rear scale plates, sword spine visible
- Back must not mirror the front

## Battle prompt block

```text
Premium stylized 2.5D mobile RPG dragon knight, tall human male heavy warrior,
horned draconic helm, charcoal dragon-scale plate with obsidian edges,
large tattered dragon wings and torn battle cape,
massive two-handed greatsword with glowing elemental core,
element accents in armor seams wings and blade only,
high-end hand-painted dark fantasy over dimensional 3D-like forms,
eye-level front three-quarter grounded combat stance, full body safe margin,
clean white plate, no global recolor, no chibi, no text, no cropped sword or wings
```
No text, no watermark, no UI, no cropped limbs or equipment.

# heal_priest (치유사제)

## Identity

- Adult human priestess healer, support role, natural 2★
- Calm oval face, long ash-blonde hair and a deep ceremonial hood
- Layered ivory robe with charcoal inner lining, fitted silver-bronze torso armor,
  long split sleeves and pointed embroidered hems
- Tall one-handed healing staff with a winged circular head and central crystal
- Rigid sun-halo frame mounted behind the shoulders; not free-floating
- Soft leather boots remain visible beneath the robe for a grounded stance
- **Keep across elements**: face, ash-blonde hair, ivory robe base, hood shape,
  staff silhouette, shoulder-mounted halo and robe layering
- **Change per element**: crystal, eye light, embroidery, metal trim and restrained
  healing particles; never recolor all cloth or change her into an attacker

## artKey

`heal_priest_{element}` — fire / water / wind / light / dark

## Element variants

- **fire**: amber crystal, red-gold embroidery, warm restorative flame motes
- **water**: teal crystal, blue-silver trim, droplets and cool healing ribbons
- **wind**: emerald crystal, green-gold stitching, leaves and soft air ribbons
- **light**: pale-gold crystal, bright ivory-gold trim and restrained holy motes
- **dark**: violet crystal, black-silver trim and controlled restorative shadow wisps

## Awaken delta

- Same face, body and staff silhouette with more ornate fitted torso armor
- Evolved double-ring shoulder halo, jeweled hood diadem and longer embroidered mantle
- Staff head gains a second wing layer and larger central crystal
- Four short spectral ribbon-wings emerge from the halo without hiding the robe
- Portrait: heal_priest_{element}_awaken.webp
- Battle: heal_priest_{element}-awaken-front.webp / -awaken-back.webp

## Front/back requirements

- **front**: face, staff head, chest emblem, both sleeves and boots readable
- **back**: halo mounting bracket, hood and hair, mantle, sleeve backs and robe panels visible
- Back keeps the staff in the same hand and is never a mirrored front

high-end hand-painted dark fantasy over dimensional 3D-like forms,

element accents only on crystal eyes embroidery trim and healing particles,
no global robe recolor, no attack pose, no text, no cropped staff or feet
```
